name: Aimogen – AI Content Writer, Editor, Chat and Automation
author: CodeRevolution

sections.description:
Aimogen brings AI-powered automation to WordPress. Generate content, auto-create posts, edit articles, summarize text, and connect with OpenAI or other models, all directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

For more information, visit the official Aimogen website

Quick Intro

Hey there! Aimogen was built to make AI content generation simple, accessible, and native to WordPress. AI driven features include: generate posts, rewrite existing posts, summarize articles, or create custom AI-driven chatbots.

The plugin connects directly with OpenAI and other AI providers through your own API key.

If you ever upgrade to Aimogen Pro, you’ll unlock features like automatic post generation from RSS feeds, AI-driven comments, custom templates, fine-tuned writing control and MUCH more. But even Lite gives you a strong start.

Core Features

AI-Powered Content Creation
Generate articles, titles, excerpts, and summaries automatically using AI. Create drafts in seconds and edit them before publishing.

AI Writer in WordPress Editor
Write or improve content directly from the WordPress editor. Generate intros, conclusions, or rewrite entire paragraphs.

Content Rewriter
Transform existing posts into fresh, unique versions. Perfect for updating old content or adapting tone and style.

AI Chatbot
Add a global chatbot to your site, allowing visitors to interact with it in an modern way.

AI Content Generation

Create content with just a few clicks.
Aimogen helps you generate blog posts, headlines, or snippets using modern AI models.

AI Writer

Improve your writing process with AI suggestions built into your workflow.

Capabilities:

Rewrite paragraphs with different tones

Generate introductions or summaries

Suggest SEO-friendly titles

Translate or rephrase content

Content Rewriter

Turn outdated content into new, engaging material.
Aimogen lets you feed existing posts or text and receive rewritten versions in seconds.

Use Cases:

Refresh old articles

Localize or rephrase posts

Maintain consistent tone across your site

Pro Features

Upgrade to Aimogen Pro for:

Automated post generation from RSS feeds

Bulk rewriting and scheduled content creation

AI image generation

AI-driven comments and suggestions

Keyword-based content prompts

Custom templates and advanced settings

Priority updates and support

Why Aimogen?

Native WordPress Integration
No external dashboards or complex setups. Everything happens right in your WP admin.

Flexible & Powerful
Supports multiple AI models and API configurations. You decide how to use it.

Optimized for Real Publishing
Unlike general AI tools, Aimogen is tuned for structured content creation and SEO-aware workflows.

Safe & Transparent
Uses your own API key. No hidden connections, no third-party data collection.

Built for Speed
Lightweight, efficient, and constantly refined for performance.

External Services

Aimogen connects to several AI APIs, depending on which features you choose to use. The plugin never sends anything unless you deliberately trigger an action such as generating text, creating an image, running a chatbot, or performing an embedding request. All calls are made using your own API keys, and no data is stored or shared by the plugin developer.

Below is a clear outline of each external service Aimogen can communicate with, what data is sent, and under which conditions. If you disable a service in the settings or never add its API key, Aimogen will not contact it.

OpenAI

Used for text generation, rewriting, chat features, assistants, and embeddings.
The plugin sends the prompt you write, model name, optional settings, and (where assistants are used) the assistant ID and related parameters. Requests are made only when you submit a generation or chatbot action.
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Stability AI

Used for image generation if you choose Stability models.
When generating an image, the plugin sends the prompt, image settings, and any related parameters you configure. Nothing is sent unless you actively generate an image through the interface.
Terms: https://stability.ai/terms-of-use

Privacy: https://stability.ai/privacy-policy

AimogenAPI (aiomaticapi.com)

Used for embeddings and related vector operations when the embedding feature is enabled.
When you run an embedding request, Aimogen sends the text you submit for embedding along with your API key and settings. No other data is transmitted.
Service site: https://aiomaticapi.com

Terms: https://aiomaticapi.com/member-tos-page/

Privacy: https://aiomaticapi.com/privacy-policy/

OpenRouter

Used when you select OpenRouter-supported models.
The plugin sends the prompt, model name, and generation settings you choose. Calls happen only when you run a generation or chatbot request.
Terms: https://openrouter.ai/terms

Privacy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy

ValueSERP

Used when running SERP-based searches through the ValueSERP API.
The plugin sends the search query and your API key.
Site: https://valueserp.com

Terms: https://valueserp.com/terms

Privacy: https://valueserp.com/privacy

SerpAPI

Another optional search provider for SERP results.
Aimogen sends the query text and your SerpAPI key.
Terms: https://serpapi.com/terms

Privacy: https://serpapi.com/privacy

Microsoft Bing Search API

Used for web searches when Bing search is selected.
Aimogen sends the query as plain text.
Terms: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement

Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com

Serper.dev

Used for Google-style search results.
Aimogen sends the search query.
Site: https://serper.dev

Terms: https://serper.dev/terms

Privacy: https://serper.dev/privacy

xAI

Used for model listings or generation where supported.
Aimogen sends the prompt, model choice and related parameters.
Site: https://x.ai

Terms & privacy: https://x.ai/legal

Replicate

Used for text-to-image or similar model runs offered by Replicate.
Aimogen sends the prompt and task parameters.
Terms: https://replicate.com/terms

Privacy: https://replicate.com/privacy

Google AI (Generative Language API / Vertex / Bison models / googleapis.com)

Used when selecting Google models for text generation.
Aimogen sends the prompt and generation settings.
Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms

Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Groq

Used when choosing Groq-hosted models.
Aimogen sends the prompt and settings you configure.
Terms: https://groq.com/terms

Privacy: https://groq.com/privacy

Perplexity

Used when enabling Perplexity text or chat generation.
Aimogen sends the prompt and model configuration.
Site: https://www.perplexity.ai

Terms: https://www.perplexity.ai/terms

Privacy: https://www.perplexity.ai/privacy

NVIDIA NIM / NVIDIA API

Used for chat or text generation through NVIDIA’s hosted LLMs.
Aimogen sends the prompt and parameters required for the model.
Terms: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/legal-info/

Privacy: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/privacy-policy/

Anthropic (Claude)

Used for text generation and chat features through Claude models.
Aimogen sends the prompt and model-related settings.
Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/terms-of-service

Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

GoAPI.ai

Used for task-based AI generation when enabled.
Aimogen sends the prompt or task ID based on the operation you run.
Site: https://goapi.ai

Terms: https://goapi.ai/terms

Privacy: https://goapi.ai/privacy

Ideogram

Used when generating images through Ideogram’s API.
Aimogen sends the prompt and image configuration.
Terms: https://ideogram.ai/terms

Privacy: https://ideogram.ai/privacy

DuckDuckGo (HTML Search Endpoint)

Used for simple search retrieval if that option is enabled.
Aimogen sends the query text only.
Privacy: https://duckduckgo.com/privacy

Google Images (public web request)

When requesting publicly available image results, Aimogen sends a standard Google search URL containing only the query.
Google terms: https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

YouTube (public URL construction)

When creating a YouTube link from a matched video ID, Aimogen does not send anything to YouTube. It only generates a URL based on the ID found in the content.
YouTube terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

PayPal (test mode only)

Used only in plugin development/testing environments for simulated transactions.
No user data is sent in normal plugin operation.
Terms: https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/ua/useragreement-full

Privacy: https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/ua/privacy-full

WooCommerce.com (test mode only)

Used only for internal testing to ping WooCommerce’s API.
No data is transmitted in normal plugin usage.
Terms: https://woocommerce.com/terms/

Privacy: https://woocommerce.com/privacy-policy/

Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service (azure.com)

Used when you configure an Azure OpenAI endpoint instead of the standard OpenAI API.
The plugin sends the prompt, model or deployment name, and generation parameters you configure. Requests occur only when you run a generation, chat, assistants, or embedding action using your Azure credentials.

Terms: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement

Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com

Disclaimer

Aimogen connects your WordPress site to external AI APIs such as OpenAI. You must use your own API key and follow the terms of the AI service you choose. For OpenAI, review their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

The plugin developer is not responsible for any damages or misuse of AI-generated content. All data is stored on your server, and it’s your responsibility to keep it secure. Read the full disclaimer here
sections.installation:
Upload aimogen to /wp-content/plugins/

Activate it through the “Plugins” menu

Go to Aimogen → Settings

Add your OpenAI API key (or another provider)

Start generating content right away
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes, Aimogen requires your own API key from OpenAI or a compatible provider.

Can it generate content automatically?

You can generate posts manually. For advanced scheduling, upgrade to Pro.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes, the AI model can generate and translate content in many languages. Quality may vary depending on the model.

Is Aimogen free forever?

Yes, the Lite version is completely free. You can upgrade anytime for more automation features.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Aimogen is lightweight and only runs on-demand during content generation.

Can I use it with Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg?

Yes, Aimogen works with all major page builders and editors.
